==Description==
'''Pipe Bomb''' is an expensive entity that can spawn anytime when inside the [[Super Epic Mode]] game modes, its the replacement for the [[Cherry Bomb|Cherry Bomb]].
==Mechanics==
Will spawn in the middle of the room, after a few seconds it will explode, killing the player if they were exposed to it, it will also break all the lockers in the same room

==Strategies==
Hide in a locker in the previous room or anywhere out of sight

==Trivia==
* '''Pipe Bomb''' is a replacement for the [[Cherry Bomb]].
* Collese, originally made this as a joke entity but it then became real after Collese made the model of '''Pipe Bomb'''.
* Ironically, Collese became a furry shortly after making this entity

* [https://youtu.be/ueu8LbHNswo?si=ppmfpG8ldsv6Y_Oi Update Executive Teaser 4.4]
